entry.title: Show HN: Making an app to organize all basic aspects of modern life (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
entry.summary: Hi, I am building a FOSS life-management app. Desktop & mobile. Bills, recipes, inventory, goals, ideas, general notes, reminders with alarm sounds... You can use AI to push/get data on it (completely optional, nothing built-in into it). You can disable features. You can self-host and run your own instance, same app with the same capabilities. I've been developing it for 6 months already, for my personal usage, and have recently released it under a FOSS license. The code is available at https://github.com/ontoplano/ontoplano Any feedback is appreciated! Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49620451 Points: 2 # Comments: 0

entry.title: Show HN: Raven - Encrypted messages hidden inside ordinary text (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
entry.summary: Solo dev. built in my spare time. Raven uses a combination of steganography and cryptography to create a metadata resistant messenger. It encrypts any piece of text on your device and stores the ciphertext on Solana. It works pairwise with keys, users decrypt locally on their device- no accounts. I do run the relayer and a retention sweeper (not claiming peer to peer). One more thing, every write is signed by the same pool wallet, so anyone can see volume/timing. Check the white paper below and there's been no audit. Several variations include: public, private, and stealth (for fun, i've hidden a public raven in this post) White Paper: https://oara.ai/raven-whitepaper The crypto and encoding core is open source. Apps are not open yet. Open source: https://github.com/OAraLabs/raven-core iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/raven-hidden-messages/id677947... Chrome: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/raven-%E2%80%94-hid... For fun public raven read key: https://sendraven.ink/k/Ot2YzGEoYYaMN1Uc Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49620394 Points: 4 # Comments: 0
